narrative_markdown:
## Today's Forecast

Slightly cooler and cloudier than yesterday; winds little changed. Showers reported at Kisumu International Airport as of 04:00, with thunder possible from the morning, peaking this evening again. Rain began at Kisumu International Airport from 03:00, ahead of the 13:00 called. 30°C / 86°F high, 19°C / 67°F low. Sky mostly cloudy early as reported, mostly cloudy at midday and overcast in the evening. Wind NNE early and SW at midday; gusts to 42 km/h (22 kt). UV index 9.5 (very high). Air quality 95 (moderate) at Ochieng' Avenue, Kisumu Central, the highest of 3 stations. As of 06:03, reports through 04:00: rain from 03:00; no thunder; high so far 21°C / 70°F; low so far 20°C / 68°F; peak sustained 7 km/h; sky mostly cloudy.

## Extended Outlook

NEXT THREE DAYS bring temperatures and winds much the same through Monday, with rain and thunderstorms likely each day. Saturday will be Overcast, Sunday Mostly cloudy, Monday Partly cloudy. Saturday sees 4 of 4 models wet with rain 13.4–53.4 mm, high 25–29 °C; Sunday 4 of 4 wet with rain 0.8–14.2 mm, high 28–30 °C; Monday 4 of 4 wet with rain 0.5–10.2 mm, high 28–31 °C. The Call forecasts rain on Day+3 with 75% chance and Day+7 with 100% chance. Record notes: best rain record on Day+0 by ECMWF, Day+3 by KMD, Day+7 by ECMWF.

## Severe Weather / Hazard Potential

Convective instability today: UKMO 3140 J/kg, ECMWF 1740 J/kg, ICON 840 J/kg and GFS 440 J/kg. Thunder possible; any thunderstorm brings sudden gusts well above the 42 km/h (22 kt) forecast.

## Winam Gulf — Conditions for Boaters

Winam Gulf wind will be east-northeasterly overnight at 6 km/h (3 kt) gusting 9 km/h (5 kt), then south-southwesterly by midday at 7 km/h (4 kt) gusting 18 km/h (10 kt), and into the evening at 11 km/h (6 kt) gusting 16 km/h (9 kt). Peak gust reaches 32 km/h (17 kt). Thunderstorm gust hazard is present as thunder is possible.

## Detailed Discussion

### Synoptic Overview

The pressure ring could not be assessed this run. Across five points, today's mean sea-level pressure sits between 1012.5 and 1014.6 hPa, near-steady over three days (+0.1 hPa). Lower pressure lies toward the southwest direction.

### Forecaster Confidence Notes

REVIEW notes that at Day+0 no model is meaningfully better than the others, though Best Match slightly under-forecasts peak wind and ECMWF slightly over-forecasts overnight lows while under-forecasting daytime highs and peak wind. The Call's rain probability aligns with the best rain record from ECMWF for Day+0, but KMD's own forecast is less detailed and does not include a wind gust figure. DATA SUFFICIENCY indicates 48 checks for the least-covered model at Day+0, offering a settled picture despite uneven coverage. Overall confidence is moderate, with model agreement on rain but some divergence on wind and temperature extremes.

extended_outlook:
Becoming calmer through Monday, with rain and thunderstorms likely each day. Skies overcast Saturday, then mostly cloudy Sunday and partly cloudy Monday. Monday's call: rain, 75%, with all four models wet; highs 28 to 31 °C. Kenya Meteorological Department (KMD) calls it dry. At this lead kenya_met has the best record, right 75% of the time over 16 checks.

Further out, cooling through Friday, with showers and thunderstorms likely Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, and showers and thunderstorms possible Friday. Tuesday: all four models wet, highs 27 to 31 °C. Wednesday: all four models wet, highs 28 to 31 °C. Thursday: all three models that reach it wet, highs 25 to 32 °C.

Only GFS, ECMWF and ICON reach past Wednesday. ECMWF and ICON are the wetter solutions from Tuesday to Wednesday; GFS and UKMO keep it drier. Friday's call: rain, 100%, with both models wet; highs around 25 °C. At this lead ECMWF has the best record, right 77% of the time over 58 checks.
